title: 第19章 像个来春游的小学生
novel_title: 贵族学院平民盲女怎么成了白月光
content_zh:
走了几步，她停下来，扶着墙，长长地呼出一口气。

    从下午两点等到下午六点，整整四个小时。

    四个小时啊！

    安怜在心里发出了无声的呐喊。

    圣罗兰贵族学院，全大陆最顶尖的贵族学院，变通度和她穿越前那个办事处处要排队的大学一样烂。

    安怜觉得自己上辈子一定是个十恶不赦的大恶人，老天爷才会让她穿书穿成一个穷得叮当响的背景板，还要同时应付三个反派男朋友，连报个名都要排四个小时的队。

    她饿得前胸贴后背，但实在没有力气去食堂了，干脆直接回了宿舍。

    薛纯不在，宿舍里安安静静的，安怜连澡都没洗，换了睡衣就直接倒在了床上。

    床铺柔软，被子温暖，她把自己裹成一个蚕蛹，只露出一张脸。

    还好牧子临这周不在。

    那个傻大个去了西方边境参加什么魔法骑士团的集训，要到下个月才回来。

    不然按照那家伙的精力，她今天绝对不可能活着去排队。

    “不行，下周选拔赛，谁都不能见。”安怜下定决心，摸出通讯终端。

    她给江彻发了条消息：【阿彻，下周我要备战选拔赛，不能见面啦，你也忙你的~】

    然后又给叶闻白发了一条：【哥哥，下周我要专心准备考试，不能陪你吃饭了，等我好消息呀~】

    发完，她也不管两人是什么回复，“啪”的一声把终端扣在床头，眼不见为净。

    周日安怜哪都没去，待在宿舍里看书、翻译文稿、养腰。

    薛纯看她那副走两步就扶腰的样子，又是心疼又是好笑，帮她打了饭，还帮她按摩了一会儿腰。

    “你这腰啊，”薛纯一边按一边说，“再这么下去迟早废了。”

    安怜趴在床上，闷闷地说：“已经废了。”

    “要不你跟叶闻白说说，让他节制点？”

    “我说了有用吗？”安怜翻了个身，对着薛纯的方向，“我跟他说别留痕迹，他嘴上说好，第二天我脖子上还是跟被蚊子咬了似的。”

    薛纯沉默了两秒：“那你跟江彻说说？”

    “江彻？”安怜冷笑一声，“我跟他说轻点，他装听不见，他跟节制这个词就不沾边。”

    薛纯又沉默了两秒，真诚地建议道：“要不你跟牧子临说说？”

    “牧子临？”安怜的声音拔高了一度，“那家伙根本听不懂人话！你跟他说轻点，他以为你在跟他调情！”

    薛纯：“……”
content_en:
After walking a few steps, she stopped, held onto the wall, and exhaled a long breath.

    From two o'clock in the afternoon until six o'clock in the afternoon, a full four hours.

    Four hours!

    An Lian let out a silent cry in her heart.

    Saint Laurent Academy of Nobles, the top aristocratic academy in the continent, was as flexible as the university where she had to wait in line at the office before she traveled.

    An Lian felt that she must have been a heinous villain in her previous life, so God would allow her to wear a book and become a poor background. She also had to deal with three villain boyfriends at the same time, and had to wait in line for four hours to even sign up.

    She was so hungry that her chest pressed against her back, but she really didn't have the energy to go to the cafeteria, so she simply went back to the dormitory.

    Xue Chun was not here, so the dormitory was quiet. An Lian didn't even take a shower. She changed into pajamas and fell directly on the bed.

    The bed was soft and the quilt was warm. She wrapped herself into a silkworm chrysalis, with only one face exposed.

    Fortunately, Mu Zilin is not here this week.

    That stupid guy went to the western border to participate in some training camp for the Magic Knights, and he won't come back until next month.

    Otherwise, with that guy's energy, she would never be able to queue up alive today.

    "No, no one can meet in the selection competition next week." An Lian made up his mind and took out the communication terminal.

    She sent a message to Jiang Che: [Arche, I have to prepare for the trials next week, so we can’t meet each other. You are also busy with your work~]

    Then he sent another message to Ye Wenbai: [Brother, I have to concentrate on preparing for the exam next week. I can’t eat with you anymore. Please wait for my good news~]

    After sending it, she didn't care what the two people's replies were, and clicked the terminal on the bedside, keeping her eyes out of sight.

    An Lian didn't go anywhere on Sunday. She stayed in the dormitory reading, translating manuscripts, and raising her waist.

    Seeing her holding her waist after taking two steps, Xue Chun felt distressed and amused at the same time. He helped her pack a meal and massaged her waist for a while.

    "What a waist you have," Xue Chun said as he pressed it, "If you continue like this, it will be useless sooner or later."

    An Lian lay on the bed and said dullly: "It's already useless."

    "Why don't you talk to Ye Wenbai and ask him to control himself?"

    "Did it help what I said?" An Lian turned over and faced Xue Chun, "I told him not to leave any traces, and he said yes. The next day, my neck still felt like a mosquito bite."

    Xue Chun was silent for two seconds: "Then tell Jiang Che?"

    "Jiang Che?" An Lian sneered, "I told him to be gentle, but he pretended not to hear. He has nothing to do with the word moderation."

    Xue Chun was silent for another two seconds and suggested sincerely: "Why don't you talk to Mu Zilin?"

    "Mu Zilin?" An Lian's voice rose a little higher, "That guy can't understand human speech at all! You speak to him softly, he thinks you are flirting with him!"

    Xue Chun: "..."
title_en: Chapter 19 Like a primary school student on a spring outing
